vsm1.7:107.4: ito dāni pabhuti sati paṭiggāhake antamaso ekālopamattampi dānaṃ adatvā na bhuñjissāmīti samādānaṃ katvā
vsm1.7:107.5: taṃdivasaṃ guṇavisiṭṭhesu paṭiggāhakesu yathāsatti yathābalaṃ dānaṃ datvā
vsm1.7:107.9: yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā viharāmi
vsm1.7:107.10: muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato’’ti evaṃ vigatamalamaccheratādiguṇavasena attano cāgo anussaritabbo.
vsm1.7:108.1: Tattha lābhā vata meti mayhaṃ vata lābhā,
vsm1.7:108.2: ye ime ‘‘āyuṃ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā’’ iti (a. ni. 5.37) ca,
vsm1.7:108.3: ‘‘dadaṃ piyo hoti bhajanti naṃ bahū’’ iti (a. ni. 5.34) ca,
vsm1.7:108.4: ‘‘dadamāno piyo hoti, sataṃ dhammaṃ anukkamaṃ’’ iti (a. ni. 5.35) ca evamādīhi nayehi bhagavatā dāyakassa lābhā saṃvaṇṇitā, te mayhaṃ avassaṃ bhāginoti adhippāyo.
vsm1.7:109.1: Suladdhaṃ vata meti yaṃ mayā idaṃ sāsanaṃ manussattaṃ vā laddhaṃ, taṃ suladdhaṃ vata me.
vsm1.7:110.3: Tasmā attano sampattīnaṃ parasādhāraṇabhāvamasahanalakkhaṇena cittassa pabhassarabhāvadūsakānaṃ kaṇhadhammānaṃ aññatarena maccheramalena abhibhūtesu sattesūti ayamettha attho.
vsm1.7:111.1: Vigatamalamaccherenāti aññesampi rāgadosādimalānañceva maccherassa ca vigatattā vigatamalamaccherena.
vsm1.7:111.2: Cetasā viharāmīti yathāvuttappakāracitto hutvā vasāmīti attho.
vsm1.7:111.3: Suttesu pana mahānāmasakkassa sotāpannassa sato nissayavihāraṃ pucchato nissayavihāravasena desitattā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmīti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.7:112.3: Sakkaccaṃ sahatthā deyyadhammaṃ dātuṃ sadā dhotahatthoyevāti vuttaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:112.6: Yācayogoti yaṃ yaṃ pare yācanti, tassa tassa dānato yācanayogoti attho.
vsm1.7:112.7: Yājayogotipi pāṭho. Yajanasaṅkhātena yājena yuttoti attho.
vsm1.7:112.8: Dānasaṃvibhāgaratoti dāne ca saṃvibhāge ca rato.
vsm1.7:112.9: Ahañhi dānañca demi, attanā paribhuñjitabbatopi ca saṃvibhāgaṃ karomi, ettheva casmi ubhaye ratoti evaṃ anussaratīti attho.
vsm1.7:113.2: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:113.3: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:113.4: Ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti cāgaṃ ārabbhāti (a. ni. 5.10)
vsm1.7:113.9: Tadetaṃ cāgaguṇānussaraṇavasena uppannattā cāgānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.7:114.1: Imañca pana cāgānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu bhiyyoso mattāya cāgādhimutto hoti,
vsm1.7:114.7:
Tasmā have appamādaṃ, kayirātha sumedhaso;
Evaṃ mahānubhāvāya, cāgānussatiyā sadāti.
vsm1.7:115.2: ariyamaggavasena samudāgatehi saddhādīhi guṇehi samannāgatena bhavitabbaṃ.
vsm1.7:115.4: ‘‘santi devā cātumahārājikā, santi devā tāvatiṃsā, yāmā, tusitā, nimmānaratino, paranimmitavasavattino,
vsm1.7:115.5: santi devā brahmakāyikā, santi devā tatuttari,
vsm1.7:115.6: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.
vsm1.7:115.7: Yathārūpena sīlena. Yathārūpena sutena. Yathārūpena cāgena.
vsm1.7:115.8: Yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) evaṃ devatā sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetvā attano saddhādiguṇā anussaritabbā.
vsm1.7:116.1: Sutte pana yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati,
vsm1.7:116.2: nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hotīti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.7:116.4: atha kho taṃ sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbadevatānaṃ attano saddhādīhi samānaguṇadīpanatthaṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.7:116.5: Aṭṭhakathāyañhi devatā sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetvā attano guṇe anussaratīti daḷhaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.
vsm1.7:117.2: aparabhāge attano saṃvijjamāne saddhādiguṇe anussarato cassa
vsm1.7:117.3: neva tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
vsm1.7:117.4: Na dosa…pe… na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
vsm1.7:117.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbhāti (a. ni. 6.10)
vsm1.7:117.9: Tadetaṃ devatānaṃ guṇasadisasaddhādiguṇānussaraṇavasena devatānussaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.7:118.1: Imañca pana devatānussatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu devatānaṃ piyo hoti manāpo,
vsm1.7:118.5:
Tasmā have appamādaṃ, kayirātha sumedhaso;
Evaṃ mahānubhāvāya, devatānussatiyā sadāti.
vsm1.7:119.1: Yaṃ pana etāsaṃ vitthāradesanāyaṃ ‘‘ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbhā’’tiādīni vatvā
vsm1.7:119.2: ‘‘ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ,
vsm1.7:119.3: labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pamuditassa pīti jāyatī’’ti (a. ni. 6.10) vuttaṃ,
vsm1.7:119.4: tattha itipi so bhagavātiādīnaṃ atthaṃ nissāya uppannaṃ tuṭṭhiṃ sandhāya labhati atthavedanti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.7:119.5: Pāḷiṃ nissāya uppannaṃ tuṭṭhiṃ sandhāya labhati dhammavedaṃ.
vsm1.7:119.6: Ubhayavasena labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjanti vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.7:120.3: devatāguṇasadise vā devatābhāvanipphādake guṇe ārabbha pavattacittavasena vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.7:121.1: Imā pana cha anussatiyo ariyasāvakānaññeva ijjhanti.
vsm1.7:122.1: Mahānāmasutte (a. ni. 6.10) ca sotāpannassa nissayavihāraṃ puṭṭhena bhagavatā sotāpannassa nissayavihāradassanatthameva etā vitthārato kathitā.
vsm1.7:123.2: ‘‘idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati, itipi so bhagavā…pe…
vsm1.7:123.3: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
vsm1.7:123.5: Idampi kho, bhikkhave, ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visujjhantī’’ti (a. ni. 6.25) evaṃ ariyasāvakassa anussativasena cittaṃ visodhetvā uttari paramatthavisuddhiadhigamatthāya kathitā.
vsm1.7:124.3: yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā…pe… nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya
vsm1.7:124.5: Idhāvuso, ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati…pe… evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavantī’’ti (a. ni. 6.26) evaṃ ariyasāvakasseva paramatthavisuddhidhammatāya okāsādhigamavasena kathitā.
vsm1.7:125.3: Upakkiliṭṭhassa, visākhe, cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
vsm1.7:125.4: Kathañca, visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti?
vsm1.7:125.5: Idha, visākhe, ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussaratī’’ti (a. ni. 3.71) evaṃ ariyasāvakasseva uposathaṃ upavasato cittavisodhanakammaṭṭhānavasena uposathassa mahapphalabhāvadassanatthaṃ kathitā.
vsm1.7:126.2: ‘‘saddho kho, mahānāma, ārādhako hoti, no assaddho.
vsm1.7:126.3: Āraddhavīriyo, upaṭṭhitasati, samāhito, paññavā, mahānāma, ārādhako hoti, no duppañño.
vsm1.7:126.4: Imesu kho tvaṃ, mahānāma, pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cha dhamme uttari bhāveyyāsi.
vsm1.7:126.5: Idha tvaṃ, mahānāma, tathāgataṃ anussareyyāsi itipi so bhagavā’’ti (a. ni. 11.11) evaṃ ariyasāvakasseva ‘‘tesaṃ no, bhante, nānāvihārena viharataṃ kenassa vihārena viharitabba’’nti pucchato vihāradassanatthaṃ kathitā.
vsm1.7:127.1: Evaṃ santepi parisuddhasīlādiguṇasamannāgatena puthujjanenāpi manasi kātabbā.
vsm1.7:127.2: Anussavavasenāpi hi buddhādīnaṃ guṇe anussarato cittaṃ pasīdatiyeva.
vsm1.7:128.1: So kirāyasmā mārena nimmitaṃ buddharūpaṃ disvā
vsm1.7:128.3: kathaṃ nu kho bhagavā na sobhati,
vsm1.7:128.5: buddhārammaṇaṃ pītiṃ paṭilabhitvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇīti.
vsm1.7:128.6:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Samādhibhāvanādhikāre
Chaanussatiniddeso nāma
Sattamo paricchedo.
